title: Candle's Create Bare Bones
description: Retextures the Create mod to better fit in with the Bare Bones resource pack, replicating the style of the trailers
body:
Simplify the machines in your world.
Retextures the 'Create' mod to better fit in with the 'Bare Bones' resource pack, bringing the textures to its bare metals.

Now with support for Crafts & Additions!
All the Ingots in Bare Metals

Compatibility
Any file should work for any Minecraft version. I've put multiple versions anyway so Minecraft won't give the "This is made for a newer/older version of Minecraft" message.

Instructions and Links
Intended for use with the 'Bare Bones' resource pack and 'Create' mod, both made by amazing people.

Want the CurseForge link? (We earn more revenue on Modrinth though so please stay here)

Have you ever thought about having the new Bedrock UI in Java, but prefer using Dark Mode? Introducing Ore UI, As Unintended!.

For other mods with Bare Bones, check out Specimen's Bare Bones Modded Compat.
